items.raw_excerpt: About 100 runners had signed up for Grindavík Ultra. The race is now cancelled after a dispute over using the town's protective barriers.

items.raw_excerpt: A tropical depression near Hainan that was once Typhoon Saudel may once again strengthen into a tropical storm as soon as late Monday, the Central Weather Administration (CWA) said, but a sea warning for waters around Taiwan is unlikely.

items.raw_excerpt: The heat has receded and autumn is almost upon us. Hanneke Sanou has a round up of ideas to keep you busy in September. items.raw_excerpt: By Julia Gurchenkova
items.summary_en: An artist and curator reflects on how visiting new places awakens the senses and fuels creativity. She describes the Venice Biennale as a perfect example, where art and the city merge to change how visitors see the world. The message is simple: travel when you can, stay curious, and let small discoveries expand your creative vision.

items.raw_excerpt: Carleton University researchers say a relatively simple preventative measure could have helped one of Ottawa's hardest hit neighbourhoods better weather the devastating rainfall this past Canada Day.

items.raw_excerpt: A British man has become the first patient in the world to undergo brain surgery with artificial intelligence assisting the surgeon in real time.
